flows.name: Spare need and fulfillment planning
steps: Register or reconcile Device Part Unit evidence under one Service Request
Aggregate active Spare Need by SR + BOM while preserving contributor relationships
Project compatible available Stock candidates
Operator chooses local, external or mixed fulfillment
Persist quantity-bearing allocations/reservations without auto-consuming the Need

flows.name: Spare Request submission
steps: Create local Spare Request over one-or-more Needs from one SR
Save Draft remains editable
Generate MSG produces an artifact only
Accept indexed sent communication or explicit manual confirmation
Atomically freeze submitted Need quantities and submission-logistics snapshot
Start response-warning chronology only after accepted submission

flows.name: RMA authorization and receipt
steps: Accept official SR7/RMA evidence manually or through reviewed communication proposal
Create/adopt RMA obligation without fabricating a physical unit
Deterministically preassign compatible target Device Part Unit when possible
Record actual inbound Spare Part Unit on physical receipt
Preserve promised BOM separately from inbound physical BOM/serial
Permit reviewed reassignment/correction without rewriting identities or source evidence

flows.name: Maintenance physical consequence
steps: Consume already-reviewed Task outcome from HLD-06
Review affected target/unit relationships
Append Inventory-owned physical consequence
Derive installed/removed/unused/faulty/incompatible/dismantled relationships
Derive applicable RMA return unit
If Task outcome is later corrected, supersede/recalculate Inventory consequence without rewriting Task history

flows.name: Fault Tag first submission
steps: Create Fault Tag draft and tracking identity
Select only eligible open RMA return obligations plus exact physical return units
Choose return method and pickup-origin Dispatch Location when required
Generate/export artifact without changing lifecycle
Accept indexed sent evidence or manual confirmation
Lock exact membership/logistics/display snapshot while current entity truth remains separately owned

flows.name: Warehouse and resend loop
steps: Record warehouse receipt per membership
Require explicit final acceptance or rejection
Acceptance closes that RMA return obligation
Rejection preserves failed attempt and leaves obligation open
Create a distinct resend Fault Tag when needed
Keep correction/replacement/resend lineage typed and history-preserving

flows.name: Communication-assisted transition
steps: HLD-10 indexes immutable source evidence
Communication adapter proposes one or more idempotent Inventory actions
Operator reviews or accepted low-risk policy approves each applicable target
HLD-08 command revalidates current Inventory state
Mutation and required audit commit atomically
Rejected/deferred proposals do not mutate Inventory

projection_rules: Stock is computed from eligible Spare Part Units and is rebuildable.
Current Inventory lifecycle state is reduced from accepted append-oriented events/relationships.
Objective-visible spare context derives through member Tasks; Inventory does not allocate units directly to Objective.
Current ticket/device context in Fault Tag views is derived from authoritative relationships rather than copied mutable truth.
